name: immersturm_predator_sacrifice_makes_it_indestructible_and_taps_it
notes: M8 mapper. Printed: 'Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.' and 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, exile up to one target card from a graveyard and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Seat 0 sacrifices its Bear: the Predator gains indestructible and becomes tapped, so its trigger exiles seat 1's graveyard card and gives it a counter (4/4). Then 9 damage does not destroy it.
